title: Combat Gambling
description: An Addon to my combat manager that lets players bet on a winner when a fight breaks out!
body:
An addon to my [completeCombatManager](https://modrinth.com/plugin/completecombatmanager) plugin which announces fights in chat, and gives players the ability to bet who who the winner will be! Betting closes in 60 seconds to ensure that ppl dont bet once the fight has a clear winner. Money goes into a pool, which winners will split. (NEEDS [VAULT](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/) AND [completeCombatManager](https://modrinth.com/plugin/completecombatmanager))
[Gui based, with chat used for specific amounts. People in fight may NOT bet on themselves.] Have fun!
